headline: Central Bank of Kenya Governor Urges Policy Frameworks to Shield African Economies
summary: Central Bank of Kenya Governor Kamau Thugge called for evidence-based policies to shield African economies from external macroeconomic shocks and preserve long-term financial stability.
why: The Central Bank of Kenya formulates monetary policy and oversees the financial system in East Africa's largest economy.

impacts.name: Kenya
impacts.why: CBK Governor called for policies to protect African economies against external shocks.
